title: Vice President, Global Channel Sales
excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal AI is looking for a VP, Global Channels to lead our global partner and channel ecosystem.
description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a VP, Global Channels to lead our global partner and channel ecosystem. Channel is already our largest route to market, driving over half of new annual contract value through resellers and distributors worldwide. This leader will take that engine to the next level.

You will own channel strategy end to end: re-energizing and deepening relationships with our top partners, driving cross-sell of our newer products into the shared customer base, expanding into strategic partners and regions where we have room to grow, and building the global team and programs to support it.

The right person operates at startup speed with a builder's mindset. You are comfortable creating programs from scratch, not just running an established playbook, and you bring credibility with partner executives around the world.

What You Will Do

  • Own and scale Abnormal AI's global partner and channel strategy across resellers and distributors in North America, EMEA, and APJ
  • Build and lead executive-level relationships with top-tier partners and open new strategic partnerships with enterprise-focused partners
  • Design and run programs, incentives, and outreach that drive cross-sell of new products into our existing customer base through the channel
  • Build the go-to-market motion that extends Abnormal AI beyond email security into new product categories through partners
  • Own Public Sector channel strategy and partner relationships
  • Build, develop, and scale a high-performing global channel organization
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product leadership to align channel strategy with company priorities
  • Establish channel performance metrics, forecasting, and reporting for executive and board-level visibility
  • Represent Abnormal AI at partner and industry events globally

AI-Forward Hiring

Abnormal AI expects GTM leaders to use AI as a structural advantage, not a productivity add-on. You should have a clear point of view on how AI changes partner enablement, deal support, and channel operations, and a track record of building teams and programs around that shift.

Must Haves

  • 12+ years in channel/partner sales leadership, including 5+ years at the VP level or above
  • Vendor-side (manufacturer) cybersecurity channel leadership experience
  • Experience leading a global channel organization (NA, EMEA, and APJ), not solely the Americas
  • Experience leading a team of 20+ through a comparable growth phase (e.g., scaling from roughly $500M to $1B+ in revenue)
  • Direct, executive-level relationships with major channel partners and distributors in cybersecurity or adjacent enterprise software
  • Ability to operate at startup speed in a hands-on, builder capacity, not solely within a large, highly resourced organization
  • Experience designing programs and incentives that drive multi-product or cross-sell adoption through partners
  • Experience with Public Sector channel dynamics, including Federal and SLED

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling a channel motion for a newly launched product category (e.g., AI-native security, identity, or SOC automation)
  • Experience with Federal channel and large-enterprise partners (e.g., global integrators, infrastructure-led partners moving into cyber)
  • Familiarity with MSP/MSSP partner motions
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$290,700—$342,000 USD

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. title: Senior IT Project Manager – Disaster Recovery & Cyber Resilience in Pharma
excerpt: The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Disaster Recovery (DR) and cyber resilience program across APAC and Europe.
description:
The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Disaster Recovery (DR) and cyber resilience program across APAC and Europe. The role focuses on establishing and expanding regional DR capabilities, enabling recovery of business-critical applications, and introducing recovery automation to improve resilience, recovery speed, and failover readiness. The Project Manager coordinates infrastructure, network, security, application, and business stakeholders to ensure critical services can be recovered within agreed recovery objectives following major disruptions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Disaster Recovery and cyber resilience initiatives across multiple regions and sites.
  • Manage the establishment of an in-region co-location DR facility, including network connectivity, storage, Nutanix, VMware, firewalls, and application onboarding.
  • Coordinate DR enablement and recovery readiness for business-critical applications, including recovery planning, testing, and site failover exercises.
  • Drive implementation of Ansible-based recovery automation, including automated technical runbooks and recovery playbooks.
  • Manage related cyber resilience initiatives, including Citrix modernization, Azure MFA, malware protection, and remediation of identified security findings.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Infrastructure, Network, Security, Applications, Business Continuity, vendors, and regional/site stakeholders.
  • Own project planning, budget, resources, dependencies, RAID management, governance, and executive status reporting.
  • Ensure DR solutions are successfully tested, documented, transitioned to operations, and capable of meeting defined recovery objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of IT project management experience, preferably in Disaster Recovery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or business continuity projects.
  • Strong understanding of Disaster Recovery concepts, business continuity, recovery testing, failover, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience in regulated pharmaceutical environments (GxP documentation).
  • Experience managing infrastructure projects involving technologies such as VMware, Nutanix, storage, networking, firewalls, and co-location/data center environments.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation and recovery orchestration; experience with Ansible is highly advantageous.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity technologies such as MFA, malware protection, Citrix, and security remediation.
  • Proven experience managing global or multi-site projects, technical vendors, risks, budgets, and cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, governance, and executive reporting skills.
  • Fluent business English and ability to collaborate effectively across global teams.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:

At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

  • Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
  • Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

WHAT WE OFFER - FUSION BENEFITS

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Growth & Development

  • Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
  • Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
  • Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

Recognition & Reward

  • Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
  • Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.
  • Stay Rewarded: Access loyalty-based benefits starting from your third year via the Unity Scheme.

Global Mobility & Local Support

  • Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
  • Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
excerpt: Overview Unified is a nationwide community of providers, operations specialists and thought leaders who look for the greatest opportunities to impact every woman’s health, at every stage of their journeys.
description:
Overview

Unified is a nationwide community of providers, operations specialists and thought leaders who look for the greatest opportunities to impact every woman’s health, at every stage of their journeys. We are unparalleled in our scale and ability to adapt to address unmet and underserved needs. Through 815+ clinics, 23 IVF labs, nationwide telehealth capabilities and targeted case management, our 2,700+ independent, affiliated providers deliver comprehensive women’s health services and continuously work to implement methods and develop techniques or platforms that improve the healthcare experience. We remain focused on enabling the discovery of new ways for our affiliated providers to deliver the high-quality care experience women deserve, in the ways they most wish to receive it, and collaborate across our community to make our vision a reality.

The Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for the payment of goods and services purchased by the organization. This role also serves as an auditor, ensuring that invoices are accurate and that proper accounting procedures are followed for the purchasing and payment of goods and services. As a member of Centralized Accounts Payable (CAP), the AP Specialist is the dedicated point of contact for assigned markets and care centers, working in Yooz and QuickBooks Online to review, code, route and pay invoices within vendor terms. The AP Specialist will assist with all matters pertaining to processing and auditing, and supports new markets and care centers as they transition to CAP. Duties include but are not limited to:


Responsibilities

Invoice processing and controls

  • Review invoices captured in Yooz for accuracy and completeness (vendor, invoice number, invoice date, current balance and care center), enter GL coding and route invoices to the assigned care center designee
  • Verify approval on all invoices and check requests, and ensure invoices are coded to the correct general ledger accounts at the proper amount
  • Monitor the market CAP mailboxes and confirm vendor submissions are forwarded into Yooz the same day for timely intake processing
  • Research possible duplicates and Smart Fraud Protection flags in Yooz, and escalate suspicious documents or atypical vendor behavior to the AP Manager
  • Research past-due balances and obtain missing invoices directly from vendors
  • Follow up with care center approvers on invoices pending approval, including rejected invoices and approver coverage during PTO
  • Process and follow up on rush items

Payments

  • Prepare and process checks and ACHes for responsible markets and care centers, coordinating with the check-printing vendor, and handling urgent and FedEx requests
  • Process utility and telecom invoices to avoid service disruption
  • Set up and maintain recurring rent payments in QuickBooks Online from landlord statements or check requests, updated annually for escalations
  • Process check requests
  • Process credit card statements (CAP), paying through the card provider portal where possible or on the next check run, and keep the statement image for reference
  • Review and approve positive pay items as assigned, in coordination with Treasury and the care center or market accounting contacts
  • Confirm paid invoice information (check or ACH number, amount and payment date) posts from QuickBooks Online to Yooz

Vendor management

  • Maintain vendor files in QuickBooks Online, including vendor names, remit addresses, terms, contacts and banking details
  • Responsible for W-9s for all new vendor setups assigned market and care centers
  • Reconcile vendor statements
  • Respond to vendor inquiries timely

Care center and market support

  • Serve as the primary contact for assigned markets on invoice questions, urgent payments and processing support
  • Support new market and care center transitions: attend onboarding meetings, review vendor readiness, and assist with other transition needs before go-live
  • Support monthly KPI reviews and weekly reporting for assigned markets
  • Support Market Accounting on various ad hoc needs and requests
  • Respond to Salesforce tickets assigned to AP daily to comply with SLA
  • Respond to all incoming calls and voicemails daily to comply with SLA

Close, reporting and projects

  • Assist with month-end and year-end closings
  • Assist with 1099 preparation
  • Special projects assigned by the AP Manager or Director of AP

Qualifications

  • 3+ years Accounts Payable experience
  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to handle confidential information in a discreet, professional manner
  • Ability to adapt to a constantly changing environment while focusing on current job responsibilities
  • Detail oriented, professional and reliable
  • Able to meet deadlines
  • Process a minimum of 100 invoices per day (500 per week)
  • Process all invoices in the AP review queue prior to month end close
  • Strong work ethic
  • Excellent customer service skills, including working with care center staff and vendors
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Understanding of internal controls, including approval workflows, duplicate payment prevention and fraud controls
  • Ability to be an effective team member and display initiative
  • Proficient with MS Word and Excel spreadsheets
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online or NetSuite preferred
  • Experience with an accounts payable workflow or invoice automation platform (such as Yooz) preferred

We’re here for you—both personally and professionally.

Our benefits are designed to support you and your family at every stage of life. From health and wellness to financial security and career growth, we offer a comprehensive package to help you thrive.

Here’s a look at what we offer:

  • Health Coverage

Medical, dental, and vision plans, fertility benefits, and supplemental insurance options.

  • Paid Time Off

Vacation, personal days, and paid holidays to help you recharge.

  • Financial & Retirement Planning

401(k) with employer contribution, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs).

  • Income Protection

Short- and long-term disability, paid parental leave, basic life insurance, and optional additional coverage.

  • Wellbeing Support

Employee Assistance Program, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and identity theft protection.

  • Professional Development

Opportunities and resources to support your career growth.

description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Director, Program Management owns delivery across the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) portfolio. This is a people-leadership role accountable for on-time delivery, program operating rhythms, dependency and risk management, and the scope, schedule, and cost tradeoffs for every program. This person will lead a team of program and project managers, set the delivery standard, and own the $25+MM CX budget in partnership with Finance and Business Operations. This person will be the single point of accountability for predictable execution and for escalating early when a dependency or decision threatens delivery.

Job Description

Why This Role Exists

DSCX owns 30+ digital products for Defense & Systems. Today our technical product managers wear three hats for their products: product management, project management, and operations. We are dividing that load across three dedicated functions, and this role will build out the program management discipline, starting with on-time delivery across the portfolio. This role is planned to have 4-6 direct reports, program and project managers, and owns the $25+MM CX budget with Finance and Business Operations. Your charge is to build standard operating rhythms and artifacts, and then coach and train your team to hold them. You should be experienced with AI and know where it creates opportunity to expand what the team can deliver.


Environment

The DSCX portfolio runs primarily on AWS, Palantir Foundry, or through SaaS based 3rd party solutions, with on-premise implementations supported for customers whose data sensitivity requires it. Delivery runs through Rally and Microsoft Teams and ServiceNow is our system of record for incidents, change, and defect management. The portfolio carries a $25+MM annual budget across the product lines.


Roles and Responsibilities

Delivery

  • Own on-time delivery (OTD) across the DSCX portfolio. OTD is the primary measure of this role. You set the target, run the cadence that surfaces risk against it, and close the gap.
  • Run the operating rhythm so problems surface early. The weekly and monthly operating reviews (WOR and MOR), standups, reviews, and retros exist to make a slipping date visible weeks out, not on the date.
  • Run Daily Visual Management across the portfolio. Delivery status and blockers are visible daily, which is what makes early escalation possible rather than aspirational.
  • Make status honest and comparable. Every major program reports RAG status, milestones, and a path to green against one standard, so leadership compares programs instead of interpreting formats.


Dependency and Risk

  • Keep programs from stalling on each other. You hold the dependency picture across DSCX and the partner teams we depend on, including Palantir, and resolve conflicts before they become schedule impacts.
  • Drive risks to closure with a named owner and a date. The RAID log is the mechanism. Closure inside the committed date is the measure.
  • Escalate early and with a recommendation. When a decision or dependency threatens a committed date, the sponsor hears it from you while there is still time to act, with the tradeoff already framed.

Scope, Schedule, and Cost

  • Own the tradeoffs. Every program has a scope, schedule, and cost triangle. You either make the call or frame the decision for whoever should.
  • Own the $25+MM CX budget with Finance and Business Operations, reconciled monthly, with committed versus actual accurate enough to plan against.
  • Control change. Approved scope, schedule, and budget changes are documented and traceable, so a program's history explains its current state.

People and Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop the program and project management team, including hiring, performance management, and talent development.
  • Set the delivery standard and make transparent execution normal, where reporting red early is rewarded rather than punished.

Minimum Qualifications

For roles in the USA:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience, OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 11 years of professional experience, OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 13 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Program Management and IT
  • Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.

Eligibility Requirement:

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Characteristics

Technical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in program and project management for enterprise digital delivery, including operating rhythms (WOR and MOR), RAID, and dependency management.
  • Experience delivering inside a defense or regulated program environment: cost and schedule baseline management, integrated master schedules, customer program reviews, and government reporting obligations.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile ways of working (Scrum and Kanban) and portfolio-level delivery governance.
  • Fluent with status reporting to RAG standards, milestone tracking, and change control.
  • Three or more years leading program or project managers, including hiring and performance management.

Business Acumen

  • Manages scope, schedule, and cost tradeoffs credibly and communicates them clearly to sponsors.
  • Owns and reconciles a budget in partnership with Finance, and tracks committed versus actual with discipline.
  • Reads risk early: distinguishes noise from red flags and drives mitigation to closure.

Leadership

  • Builds a function from a small team.
  • Makes red safe to report.
  • Escalates without drama.
  • Coaches with questions before positions.
  • Leads a distributed team on purpose.

Key Success Metrics

  • Cadence health: completeness and timeliness of monthly status reports; operating rhythm adherence.

Sr. Director, Talent Acquisition

Job Location: United States, Remote

About the company:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

About the role

We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.

What you'll do

  • Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.
  • Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.
  • Define and run a KPI framework (for example time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, quality of hire, hiring manager satisfaction, recruiter productivity). Review it on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.
  • Build and apply AI across the recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, outreach, reporting, and recruiter performance insights. Measure the efficiency and quality gains, and retire what does not work.
  • Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.
  • Manage and optimize agency and vendor relationships: when to use them, how to hold them accountable, and how to reduce reliance over time.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executives, hiring managers, and People leadership. Run intake and workforce planning conversations, push back with data, and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Move between strategy and execution: build the plan in the morning, close the candidate in the afternoon.
  • Partner with Finance, People Ops, and Talent Brand on headcount planning, forecasting, employer brand, DEI goals, and candidate experience.
  • Build the TA leadership bench: hire, develop, and promote recruiting managers, senior recruiters, and sourcers; define career paths and succession plans.
  • Run the team's operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, and regular reporting to the executive team.
  • Own the TA budget, including headcount, agency and vendor spend, tools, and job board and event costs. Forecast capacity against the hiring plan and make the case for investment.
  • Lead TA technology strategy: ATS configuration, sourcing and scheduling tools, analytics, and vendor selection and renewals.
  • Build scalable, consistent hiring practices, including structured interviewing, intake standards, interviewer training, offer approval, and candidate experience.
  • Lead through change: reorganizations, hiring surges and freezes, reprioritization, and integration of acquired teams.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading TA teams, ideally including a Director-level or higher role.
  • Experience in fast-paced, high-growth, or dynamic environments with high requisition volume and a small team.
  • Direct experience recruiting in North America (US, Canada, Mexico) and India, and an understanding of how each market differs.
  • A clear point of view on performance management and KPIs, with examples of setting goals, holding people accountable, and coaching up or out.
  • Experience in both agency and corporate recruiting.
  • Demonstrable examples of using AI to improve recruiting efficiency and performance management, with outcomes you can quantify.
  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder skills, including with senior leaders.
  • Fluency with an ATS and recruiting analytics.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as the business changes.
  • A track record of building and leading TA teams through growth and change, including hiring, developing, and retaining recruiting managers and individual contributors.
  • Experience managing leaders and managers, plus a distributed team across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience owning a TA budget and a hiring plan, including capacity modeling and agency and vendor spend.
  • Experience building or rebuilding a recruiting operating model: team structure, process, tooling, and reporting.
  • Experience presenting TA strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences, and partnering with Finance on workforce planning.
  • Experience leading a team through a reorganization, hiring surge, or slowdown, and keeping morale and performance up.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or technology.
  • Experience scaling TA through growth, restructuring, or M&A.
  • Experience hiring across engineering, sales, and go-to-market roles.
  • Working knowledge of employment practices in Mexico and India.

You will shape how customers understand the value of these solutions, influence product direction in partnership with Product Management and Engineering and drive measurable business outcomes. This role will ideally be based in either Prague, Czech Republic or Limassol, Cyprus
Or remotely in Europe or the EU.

What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)

    You will be responsible for specific areas across Azul Intelligence Cloud, Azul Optimizer Hub, and Payara InSight, working closely with other product managers and cross-functional partners. You will help shape product strategy, roadmap priorities, pricing and packaging, market positioning, and business performance for your areas. You’ll use customer insight, market data, and business results to recommend direction, build alignment, and drive decisions across product, engineering, sales, and marketing.

    The balance of your focus across the three products will evolve as business priorities change. These products are also closely connected to Azul’s Java runtimes: Optimizer Hub ships as part of Azul Prime, while Intelligence Cloud’s JVM Inventory supports Azul Core Oracle migration initiatives. Your work will therefore influence broader product and runtime priorities, and at times may include direct involvement with Azul Core and Azul Prime.

Partner with sales, marketing, engineering, and leadership to understand performance, identify opportunities or risks, and adjust product direction when the data or customer feedback indicates a change is needed.

    • Shape product strategy.

  • Develop and recommend the multi-year direction for your areas, including where the products can differentiate, which customer segments and use cases to prioritize, and where Azul should build, partner, or integrate. Ensure your recommendations reflect customer needs, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, technical considerations, and Azul’s broader enterprise and open-source portfolio.

    • Partner with executive leadership.

Present product strategies, roadmap recommendations, pricing considerations, customer insights, and business results clearly and credibly. Use evidence to support recommendations, invite constructive challenge, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

Contribute to customer-facing technical documentation and knowledge-base content, deliver compelling product demonstrations, and continually evaluate the usability of the product.

Help ensure product messaging resonates with developers, platform teams, technical decision-makers, and executive buyers.

You do not need to be a JVM internals expert, but you should understand JVM architecture and operating principles, including JIT compilation and warm-up, well enough to have substantive conversations with engineering and translate technical capabilities into meaningful customer and business value.

  • Provide technical leadership and participate in design discussions, coding, code reviews and troubleshooting when required.
  • Drive the adoption of modern front-end and back-end technologies and the continued evolution of CaRMS’ technology platform.
  • Lead the transition from legacy Java and WebLogic systems to newer technology stacks such as Python and Laravel, while maintaining and supporting legacy systems during the transition.
  • Lead end-to-end solution design for the current product portfolio and next-generation offerings.
  • Identify and address key operational “dissatisfiers” and opportunities to improve the user and client experience.
  • Collaborate with the Product team on user experience and interaction design.
  • Develop, maintain and execute the product roadmap in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
  • Guide product in translating business needs into clear requirements and priorities aligned with CaRMS strategy and match-cycle timelines.
  • Plan, prioritize and oversee project and non-project work across the Product Development team.
  • Monitor and report on team performance, delivery, risks, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with CaRMS managers to identify and prioritize technology and software development requirements.
  • Work effectively with internal and external development partners, establishing clear expectations around scope, quality, budgets, delivery and knowledge transfer.
  • Develop and review technical aspects of software services contracts.
  • Maintain appropriate product, technical and operational documentation and reporting.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Mandatory Requirements

  • University degree in Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on software development experience, including experience with Agile methodologies.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience leading or managing developers and technical specialists.
  • Hands-on experience with modern web application stacks such as Python and Laravel, with the ability to work with legacy Java and WebLogic applications.
  • Experience working with external development partners or contractors alongside an internal development team, including managing scope and deliverables.
  • Experience with product ownership or product management practices, including backlog prioritization, requirements definition and roadmapping.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching and developing team members and managing performance and interpersonal challenges.
  • Experience in a service delivery environment where the product and service are heavily dependent on a client-facing IT platform.
  • Working knowledge of digital user experience design, including online and mobile environments.
  • Proven ability to work successfully with highly capable software development teams.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in an entrepreneurial, start-up or scale-up environment with broad ownership and responsibility.
  • Familiarity with Datadog, GitHub, Jira, Claude and Figma.
  • Experience leading technology modernization or platform transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing a blended team of internal employees and external development partners.
  • Experience driving continuous improvement across technology, product and delivery practices.

Competencies: Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong technical knowledge of software development, product delivery and Agile practices.
  • Strategic and design-thinking mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to build trust and high-performing teams.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate priorities, risks, dependencies and progress to senior leadership.
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear product priorities and delivery plans.
  • Ability to guide technology evolution, encourage innovation and manage technical debt.
  • Strong relationship-management skills when working with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Demonstrated commitment to developing people and creating opportunities for growth.
  • Adaptable, accountable and comfortable working in a changing, growth-oriented environment.

The Successful Candidate

The successful candidate is a hands-on technology leader who combines strong software development expertise with effective people and product leadership. They understand both the technical and business context behind what is being built and can move comfortably between strategic priorities, team leadership and technical problem-solving.

They are collaborative, adaptable and highly accountable, with the ability to create clarity in a complex environment, build strong relationships across teams and partners, and communicate confidently with senior leadership. They bring sound judgment, curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to balance speed, quality, innovation and sustainable technology practices.

Most importantly, they are comfortable leading and doing — staying close enough to the technology to make informed decisions and contribute when needed, while providing the leadership, direction and accountability required to grow the Product Development function.

CaRMS is committed to fostering an equitable, diverse, and inclusive workplace. The Canadian Resident Matching Service (CaRMS) is a national, independent, not-for-profit organization that provides digital solutions and expertise that matches medical students with training opportunities in Canada.

CaRMS’ mission is to serve as trusted stewards, builders, and innovators of data-informed application and matching services. Our vision is to provide the best possible outcomes for both applicants and faculty through safe, fair, and equitable application and matching systems.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

(CWS) seeks a Senior Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).
description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Senior Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).

The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP locations, and remote users. The role maintains a clear division of responsibility with cybersecurity personnel who identify, prioritize, and validate findings, while the Endpoint Engineer tests and implements approved changes through change control and provides deployment evidence for validation.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Serve as senior engineer for enterprise endpoint imaging, packaging, deployment, patching, configuration, and VDI capabilities.
    • Design, build, test, and maintain standardized endpoint images, including drivers, OS settings, security baselines, and required software, and establish image versioning, release, rollback, and retirement procedures.
    • Develop automated deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, enrollment processes, and configuration profiles using Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable platforms.
    • Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software with installation, detection, dependency, upgrade, and removal logic, and test and troubleshoot package deployments.
    • Develop and maintain approved scripts and automation for provisioning, packaging, configuration, and remediation in version-control repositories.
    • Design and administer endpoint patching for operating systems, applications, drivers, and firmware, establishing pilot groups, deployment rings, maintenance windows, and exception processes; test updates and monitor compliance.
    • Engineer and support VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, and user profiles; troubleshoot login, profile, performance, and connectivity issues; and coordinate dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, and identity teams.
    • Support endpoint deployment and refresh projects, OS upgrades, application migrations, and endpoint-management transitions, developing technical implementation plans.
    • Provide Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering support for complex endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents, including major incidents and root-cause corrective actions, and improve Service Desk and field-support knowledge content.
    • Review cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations, assess operational impact and rollback needs, implement approved remediation through change and release procedures, and provide completion evidence; apply DISA STIGs and endpoint-security baselines.
    • Maintain endpoint inventories, image and package records, patch status, VDI documentation, SOPs, and deployment and rollback plans, and provide endpoint health and compliance information for program reporting.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.
    • Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related discipline.
    • Experience designing and maintaining enterprise endpoint images and developing, testing, and deploying application packages.
    • Experience supporting endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, lifecycle management, and VDI.
    • Experience implementing endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes using controlled testing, phased deployment, validation, and rollback practices.
    • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

      • Preferred:

      • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, Defender for Endpoint, and Entra ID hybrid endpoint management.
      • Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or comparable endpoint-automation technologies.
      • Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.
      • Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.
      • Experience supporting federal or DoD endpoint environments, including DISA STIGs and RMF remediation evidence.
      • Experience supporting large-scale OS migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.

Certifications

    • Required: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.
    • Preferred: CompTIA Security+ or another security certification, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, or automation certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Occasional after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

      • Administrative Notes:

      Period of Performance: March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033

      Contract Start Date: March 1, 2027

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will join a growing multi-state healthcare organization delivering outpatient physical therapy, medical care, and specialized clinical laboratory services across dedicated clinics and integrated wellness facilities. You will take strategic and hands-on ownership of the patient journey—from first inquiry and physician referral through ongoing treatment evaluations, cross-service utilization, and return-to-care engagement.

This is a dynamic, impact-driven role for a marketer who pairs strategic journey architecture with day-to-day CRM campaign execution. Operating across multi-location clinical service lines, you will spearhead initiatives that turn organic interest, partner channels, and campaign-driven traffic into booked, attended appointments. Rather than functioning purely as a CRM administrator, you will serve as the primary engine for conversion optimization, lifecycle segmentation, and service-line expansion, ensuring every patient touchpoint is timely, clinically validated, and effective.

Accountability

As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, your success will be defined by your ability to increase qualified patient inquiries and accelerate conversion into attended clinical evaluations and visits across all service lines.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Organic & Physician-Referral Conversion Optimization

  • Own the end-to-end messaging and conversion strategy for physician referrals, organic search inquiries, website visitors, and partner facility foot traffic.
  • Map clear patient lead journeys tailored to specific intent, source, clinic location, and readiness to schedule.
  • Design dedicated nurturing journeys for unbooked inquiries while building pre-visit engagement workflows for scheduled appointments.
  • Partner directly with front desk leadership to standardize response times, outreach messaging templates, lead disposition tracking, and scheduling handoffs.
  • Continuously evaluate and eliminate friction points preventing qualified prospective patients from booking evaluations.

Patient Engagement, Retention & Re-Engagement

  • Develop targeted retention and return-to-care communications for existing and previous patients across physical therapy, medical, and laboratory service lines.
  • Segment clinical patient databases using approved operational, behavioral, and service-line criteria.
  • Build compliant cross-service engagement campaigns that educate patients on relevant secondary services.
  • Coordinate omni-channel messaging across GoHighLevel, Phreesia, and integrated communication tools to avoid message collision or oversaturation.
  • Work alongside clinical leadership to validate medical claims, clinical appropriateness, and communication preferences.

Campaign-Generated Acquisition & Paid Partnership Alignment

  • Architect target audience criteria, campaign offers, messaging frameworks, and follow-up journeys for prospects generated through marketing initiatives.
  • Support new patient acquisition originating from gym facility partnerships, community initiatives, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop service-line acquisition roadmaps in alignment with overall business growth, prioritizing expanding medical services alongside physical therapy and lab offerings.
  • Partner closely with the paid media specialist by supplying creative briefs, target audience hypotheses, landing page conversion requirements, and lead quality feedback.
  • Build targeted nurture automations that rapidly move paid and partner interest into confirmed clinical visits.

CRM Campaign Management & Workflow Automation

  • Independently build, launch, and manage segmented email and SMS campaigns within the established CRM infrastructure.
  • Configure routine automation workflows, communication triggers, audience segments, and delivery cadences in GoHighLevel.
  • Define and enforce entry, exit, re-entry, and suppression rules, guaranteeing that promotional nurturing ceases immediately upon confirmed booking.
  • Conduct rigorous pre-launch quality assurance across clinic location details, functional links, consent permissions, and lead routing logic.
  • Maintain up-to-date campaign calendars, workflow directories, technical change logs, and standard operating playbooks.

New Service-Line Launch Execution & CRO Testing

  • Audit current clinical programs to identify missing lifecycle journeys, content gaps, and operational handoff requirements.
  • Determine which service-line marketing paths should be optimized, maintained, restructured, or built from the ground up.
  • Draft technical implementation briefs for the external CRM systems consultant when complex architectural changes or custom API integrations are needed.
  • Formulate and execute structured A/B tests covering subject lines, messaging angles, SMS timing, calls to action, and landing page experiences.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks between marketing touchpoints and appointment scheduling, systematically rolling out winning playbooks across all clinic locations.

Lifecycle Analytics, Attribution & Data Reconciliation

  • Establish baseline performance scorecards across each service line, campaign source, and clinic facility.
  • Track and evaluate new qualified leads independently from returning patient reactivations.
  • Measure true commercial pipeline outcomes, focusing on confirmed bookings, actual clinic attendance, and completed visits rather than top-funnel vanity metrics.
  • Audit CRM data to uncover unrecorded outcomes, misattributed channels, or broken operational handoffs, partnering with operations to ensure data reconciliation.
  • Deliver actionable, data-backed recommendations to leadership to optimize patient lifetime value and acquisition efficiency.

Colleagues

You will report directly to the National Director of Operations and collaborate closely with clinic Operations, Front Desk teams, Marketing counterparts, Clinical Directors, and an external CRM technical consultant who supports advanced platform architecture. You will also partner with the paid media specialist to align acquisition traffic with downstream nurture journeys. At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, your vertical strength will be lifecycle marketing strategy and hands-on CRM journey execution, while your horizontal capabilities should span conversion rate optimization, cross-functional clinical coordination, and marketing analytics.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: At least 4 years of demonstrated ownership in lifecycle marketing, CRM management, marketing automation, or conversion-focused campaign strategy, with a track record of driving measurable pipeline or booking growth.
  • Tools & Systems: Hands-on proficiency building automated email and SMS journeys in GoHighLevel or comparable enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo), with multi-location setup experience considered a strong advantage. Familiarity with WordPress, Google Workspace, RingCentral, or healthcare tools like Phreesia and athenaOne is preferred.
  • Analytics & Process: Deep understanding of customer journey mapping, list segmentation, suppression logic, testing methodologies, and funnel attribution. Proven ability to analyze full-funnel conversion metrics, audit data integrity, and distinguish marketing attribution issues from front-desk operational delays.
  • Mindset & Approach: Highly organized and autonomous self-starter with exceptional written communication, strong attention to detail, and the discretion required to manage sensitive patient communications in alignment with clinical compliance standards.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Lifecycle Strategy & Journey Mapping: How do you design and prioritize multi-touch email and SMS nurture journeys across distinct service lines and audience segments?
  • CRM Execution & Workflow Logic: How do you structure triggers, suppression rules, and quality assurance checks inside a CRM to prevent message collisions and ensure timely outreach?
  • Conversion Rate Optimization & Testing: How have you diagnosed bottlenecks between lead capture and appointment booking, and what systematic testing frameworks did you use to improve conversion?
  • Data Integrity & Performance Attribution: How do you track campaign success through to attended appointments, reconcile discrepancies between marketing and operational records, and deliver actionable insights?
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Medical Discretion: How do you collaborate with operational staff, paid media teams, and clinical leadership to ensure messaging remains commercially compelling yet operationally and clinically sound?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

Job Summary

If you like owning problems end to end, making security a default property of everything we build, and working closely with engineering, we want to meet you. Bugcrowd is looking for security engineers who move beyond standard tooling and drive measurable security outcomes our customers can rely on. You will help us shape a culture where security helps others succeed, not just points out problems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner Closely with Engineering: Refine architecture, validate new features, and drive security investment while prioritizing engineering velocity
  • Build Security Paved Roads: Contribute to the secure defaults, libraries, and "paved roads" that systematically eradicate entire classes of vulnerabilities rather than fixing bugs one by one
  • Create Feedback Loops: Tune security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning to reduce noise and focus on what matters
  • Be our Best Customer: Ensure our bug bounty program can be a model for other customers. Experiment with new ways to leverage the creativity of the crowd. Provide feedback on new platform features to engineering and product
  • Own Projects End to End: Lead cross-functional product security projects from scoping through delivery, influencing product and engineering roadmaps and clearly communicating risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Amplify our Impact: Use code and automation as a lever to scale coverage and eliminate repetitive work. Build systems based on incentives and accountability rather than just bureaucratic process

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 3+ years of experience in product security, application security, or secure software development
  • Can review code, automate tasks, and build security tooling in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby, Java)
  • Hands-on experience with core application security practices — threat modeling, secure code review, and automated testing (SAST, DAST, SCA) — and a solid grasp of common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects and influence cross-functional partners across engineering, DevOps, and product.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points (Preferred but not required)

  • Previous experience with Bug Bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs
  • A background in building "paved roads" or secure-by-default internal libraries to eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities
  • Hands-on experience securing cloud-native platforms and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience working within a fast-paced, high-growth security or SaaS company

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time
  • Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.
  • Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time

Culture

  • At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.
  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.
  • Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

Disclaimer

This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the technologies of Bugcrowd. It is essential that the applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in the strictest confidence.

The company is authorized to obtain background checks for employment purposes under state and federal law. Background checks will be conducted for positions that involve access to confidential or proprietary information (including trade secrets).

Background checks may include Social Security verification, prior employment verification, personal and professional references, educational verification, and criminal history. Applicants with conviction histories will not be excluded from consideration to the extent required bylaw.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

About Picus

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Description

​​Centralized monitoring is an integral part of a risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers, and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.

The central monitor is responsible for conducting a holistic and centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock according to the centralized monitoring plan, using analytical tools to identify emerging and existing risks to critical study data and process. The central monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level. ​

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • ​​Follow established procedures for the review of clinical trial data (Operational and Subject data) using a variety of tools and systems in alignment with the centralized monitoring plan and with support from the senior team members.
  • ​Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site and track the evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
  • ​Ensure results of reviews are appropriately documented per procedures.
  • ​Support Central Monitoring teams with performance of assigned reviews with high quality, on-time results.
  • ​Provide input to senior team member as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.
  • ​Support review set-up as directed by assigned lead including updating department database, pulling reports, etc. as assigned.
  • ​Share the responsibility for data quality at the study, country and site levels.​

Requirements

Education

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

Experience

  • ​Minimum of 1 year of experience in central statistical monitoring with overall 6 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
  • ​Basic understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
  • ​Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
  • ​Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS, etc.).
  • ​Good computer skills, with knowledge of advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
  • ​Ideally a basic level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
  • ​Must have been involved in the analysis and review of clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
  • ​Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.

Attributes

  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels in an organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Satisfactory understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

Note that this opening is for a home-based position in Philippines. Attendance at some meetings outside of regular business hours (primarily in the evening) is required.

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology and Rheumatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.
